correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs every possible first force with a white hub and invokes the one-leak cycle propagation lemma once the hub is blue. This yields an if-and-only-if classification for all n>=4. Closed walks of the explicit pair-bit automaton count selected 111 windows exactly; a determinant computation gives the rational ordinary generating function. Minimal sets are the inclusion-minimal unions of two selected triples. The embedded standalone program checked every initial set against all possible leak positions for rim lengths 4 through 11, and independently compared transfer counts to cyclic enumerations through length 16. These finite checks support, but do not replace, the symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: The October 2019 public preprint introduced leaky forcing, and the fully read 2024 journal Proposition 3.6 obtains the scalar wheel one-leak minimum 3 without an all-set polynomial or classification of inclusion-minimal sets. The May 2026 full-text modular-compression paper provides a universal fort-profile enumeration, but gives neither the wheel evaluation by cyclic 111 windows nor its three-size minimal spectrum; its generic exponential method is acknowledged as applicable, not dismissed. Indexed records on wheel connected forcing, ordinary forts, and positive-semidefinite forcing have different predicates; no covering specialized wheel theorem was identified. This is a provisional mathematical originality assessment, not a claim of publication-priority proof.
residual_risks: Not all full texts of indexed nearby wheel studies were accessible; the connected-forcing summary gives a different predicate, but unavailable appendices cannot be fully excluded.
The 2019 preprint bibliographic evidence was inspected but its complete original text was not; a closely corresponding 2024 full journal exposition of the wheel result was inspected.

The universal 2026 fort-compression framework computes this polynomial by generic enumeration; the new work is the explicit closed specialization and minimal classification, not a claim that generic computability is new.
Unindexed or independently discovered one-leak wheel enumerations remain possible.

value.rationale: Prior wheel leaky-forcing work provides the minimum sensor count but not a count of all fault-tolerant placements. This natural resilience census has a fixed-state exact polynomial, a simple two-window local certificate, and a nonpure minimal-set spectrum {3,4,6} from n=8 with no size-five inclusion-minimal sets. The first size-six class has n(n-7)/2 placements, a quadratic count arising from two independently usable forcing routes. These are structural placement distinctions of potential use in robust monitoring and not routine restatements of the known scalar minimum.
